verdict.rationale: Crossmint's API reference explicitly lets users "explore the APIs and test them live from the browser" and "call the APIs directly from the browser". Concrete reference pages exist for onramp and offramp endpoints, which covers an interactive reference with runnable requests. The probe found no public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, but that does not contradict the in-browser playground. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the live playground works, and evidence of copyable multi-language code samples on the reference pages.
